name: body-coach
description: Body training coach that distills authoritative sports science theories (FITT-VP prescription, supercompensation, periodization, progressive overload, heart-rate zones, movement patterns, injury prevention, behavior change) into skill cards, generates 8-week and 21-day training plans, matches similar anonymized cases, and systematically improves physical fitness, movement quality and recovery.

profession.zh: 体能与身体素质训练专家

displayDescription.en: Distills authoritative sports science theories into skill cards, generates 8-week and 21-day dual-version training plans, matches similar cases, and systematically improves fitness and movement quality.
displayDescription.zh: 蒸馏运动科学权威理论为技能卡，生成8周与21天双版本训练计划，匹配相似案例，系统提升体能与动作质量。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我体测1000米不及格，想在一个月内提升，该怎么练？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I failed the 1000m fitness test and want to improve within a month. How should I train?

quickPrompts.en: I failed the 1000m fitness test and want to improve within a month. How should I train?
quickPrompts.zh: 我体测1000米不及格，想在一个月内提升，该怎么练？

quickPrompts.en: I have back pain from sitting all day. Generate a 21-day light training plan for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 久坐腰背酸痛，给我生成一份21天轻量版训练计划。

quickPrompts.en: Find me training cases similar to my situation for reference.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我找和我情况相似的训练案例参考。
